lh2_dad.text: Mind the wellies. It rained last night. It will rain tonight. It is a very reliable village.
My little one has a word for everything. Her favourite is hwyl: spirit, fun, the good feeling at a good gig.
I have spotted a dipling on the shore a few times. It is small and shy. I take a biscuit and sit very still.

then.text: Back for the Cawl? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: Dere i mewn, cariad. That means come in, love. You look like you need cawl.
Lamb, leeks, swede and a bit of everything. A wooden spoon in the pot and a hunk of cheese on the side. Cawl's never made the same way twice.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
